messages:
Alex Moreno: heads up — planning to spin up a short-lived demo Dedicated pool in us-central1 for next week's customer walkthrough. Before I submit a formal request, quick check: any known A100/H100 spot tightness or quota gotchas in us-central this week?

Sophia Chen: @Alex Moreno we had a soft quota hit yesterday on A100 preemptibles but that was for a sustained training job. short bursts were fine. :eyes:

Rav Patel: Can you share ETA and required size? also do we need regional vs multi-zone?

Alex Moreno: target is ~4xA100 (32G) for ~6 hours (can be burst/ephemeral). prefer multi-zone for resilience but can do single zone if quota easier. aiming for noon Tue.

Tim O'Neill: tagging infra ops — if it's ephemeral, i'd prefer we use spot blend and fallback to h100-sliced instances if quota blocks. also need a PR to change pool labels so billing shows demo.

Leah (vendor-ops): i'm pinging our rep, they said us-central1 has limited H100 reserved capacity this week but some A100 capacity is free. will confirm rack-level ETA.

GCP-Alloc-Bot: Quota check summary for project/redwood-demo: \n```\nregion: us-central1\nA100-32G QUOTA: allocated 12 / limit 16\nH100-80G QUOTA: allocated 8 / limit 8\npreemptibleA100: allocated 6 / limit 8\n```\n
Sophia Chen: bot shows H100 at limit — so fallback plan needed. Alex, can we accept mixed A100/H100?

Alex Moreno: yes mixed is fine. prefer A100 primary. If H100 required, ok but prefer not to rely on it.

Rav Patel: i'll open a short-lived quota bump request to GCP for preemptibleA100 +2 and tag it as emergency/demo-ops. PR: #4123 — includes TF change to pool sizing and a canary flag.

Tim O'Neill: quick checklist for launch: 1) PR merged 2) quota approved 3) infra runbook updated (canary rollback) 4) billing label verified. I can own runbook edits.

Leah (vendor-ops): rep confirmed they can push 2x preemptible A100 for the window but need a committed time + account rep approval. I'll drop the confirmation here once they ack.

Alex Moreno: thanks — i'll update PR with the exact time and add the billing label changes. if quota doesn't land by EOD monday we'll pivot to a smaller demo (2xA100) and flag the customer. :thumbsup:

Sophia Chen: FYI i'm adding an autoscaler override to keep instance spin-up within the first 5 minutes to avoid cold-start token spikes.

Rav Patel: added request link: https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/quotas?project=redwood-demo (marked as high priority)

GCP-Alloc-Bot: Quota request created (id: qr-99871) status: PENDING. Notified GCP account rep.

Alex Moreno: perfect. thanks everyone — i'll post a final go/no-go here after quota update.
